history.en: Ramen was introduced by Chinese immigrants and can trace its history to Yokohama’s Chinatown in the late 1800s.
history.zh: 拉面是由中国移民引入的，其历史可以追溯到19世纪末横滨的唐人街。

history.en: We accept that they are British because of their history.
history.zh: 因为它们的历史，我们接受它们是英国的。

history.en: Nuclear power has a long history of projects that were promised on time and on budget, and then arrived years late and billions over.
history.zh: 在核电领域，承诺按时完工、不超预算，最终却拖延数年并超支数十亿美元的项目屡见不鲜。
